schedule.quick_tip: Ensure all spices, marinades, and sides are ready to avoid last-minute store runs.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towels before seasoning for better flavor absorption and crispiness.
Use a meat thermometer to ensure an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C) without drying it out.
Soak cookware immediately after plating to make cleanup effortless.
